name: Ak Bars Bank (PJSC "AK BARS" BANK)
note: Largest bank of Tatarstan (cbonds.ru profile, opened 2026-10-03). Largest shareholders above 10% per that profile: State Housing Fund under the President of the Republic of Tatarstan 20.41%, Republic of Tatarstan 19.79%, AO Svyazinvestneftekhim 13.61%, PAO Tatneft 10.41%. Single-sourced, and the figures match a list reported as of 15 June 2020 (possible stale echo of the bank's old disclosure); the bank's own disclosures (akbars.ru, e-disclosure.ru) block scripted access and its redacted 2025 IFRS statements withhold shareholder detail.
